name: Egyptian Lateral Raise
instructions: Set a cable pulley to its lowest position and attach a single handle. Stand side-on to the machine with your feet close to its base.
Hold the handle with your far hand, so the cable crosses in front of your body. Hold the frame of the machine with your near hand.
Lean away from the machine until your near arm is straight, at an angle of about 15 to 30 degrees.
Keep the lean and a slight bend in your working elbow. Raise your arm out to the side until it is a little above shoulder height. Lead with the elbow and do not shrug.
Lower the handle slowly until your hand is in front of your hip. Do all the repetitions, then change sides.
